note: Scripture follows the Kulish Bible (1905), parsed from the ebible mirror (ukr_pan USFM). A `mined` row's quoted span in that block is a verbatim (case-insensitive) substring of the Kulish verse; Kulish orthography (ї, сьв-, -є) is kept inside quotations. Cited paraphrases and allusions that the English does not put in quotation marks are not listed; Calvin’s miscited references are named in the PR.

Calvin cites in Roman numerals and several citations are wrong in the English (Rom. vii. 36 for 8:36, Matt. viii. 38, Luke xii. 10, Heb. iii. 9, I Cor. iv. 12). The body renders each citation as printed (digits converted); the row here names the verse actually quoted.
Hebrews is cited as «Євреїв», not Kulish's running head «Жидів», following the shipped uk corpus.
